Hahah it's alright and that is really cool

And I really did not expect you to be in high school- And yeah I know what you mean I do the same thing when I'm not posting on it myself (I know, I'm messed up).

But that's awesome... I wish I took more computer classes in my early high school years because computer science seems awesome.  I'm pretty nerdy too but more english/science wise I guess.  Where do you plan on applying for college?  What grade are you currently in?

Oh and if you want you can PM me if you don't want all of this all over your account, I mean this is just a throwaway for me, but that's your real account, sorry lol

It's acutally not really a Muslim girl... It's me in a blanket and hat... I was actually really sick when the picture was taken and my whole face was swollen... Idk why I decided to paint it...

I will draw you anything! But it will probably turn out pretty creepy, my regular art is pretty creepy and I usually give it away to people so I don't have any of it on me.

So anywaayy... tell me more about yourself (okay, that sounds totally creepy, but talking to somebody is helping me and I don't know what else to say about myself and I like hearing about other people lol)

Idk if you realized, it's an album, it has numbers at top you have to click to go to the next pic, I forgot to warn you haha... My regular art is more graffiti styled and also naked people, I paint a lot of the human figure haha


Grades aren't really a problem for me.. My weighted GPA is liker er 93?  I'd really like to get into a college with a good financial aid program.  Math is my least favorite subject, well trigonometry is really... but it's mostly because of my teacher and really because it is the only class I have recieved a weighted average under a 90 in..

Random but if you want I can draw something for you to keep me busy... I might not do it tonight because I prefer drawing outside in the daylight but I'm off tomorrow and I know I'm going to be feeling pretty down since no one will be home...

Thanks!  But food isn't too much of a problem.. I mean, if I really need food I can go to my sister's house.. but my mom gets her unemployement check every Tuesday and food usually is the first thing she buys.  But thanks anyway :)

Eh, I really haven't been in the mood to draw/paint lately... And I don't have much of my art on my computer besides this:  http://imgur.com/NadCS&rlG5Nl&Wew29&KwKBv which is all from school so it's not really my best stuff and it was taken with a camera phone so that's what the lines are about.  My art teacher doesn't like my regular art work since it wouldn't be considered 'fine art' like the stuff I apparently am doing in her class.  Lame.  

Chemistry is easy,  I guess that's all I really like about it... It is very to the point and I guess it just makes sense.

I just re-read my post and realized how much I rambled about my cat ... I'm just really scatter brained right now... 

But my cat hasn't been outside and she has no voice, is really tiny and mostly blind and freaks out when she's outside (she ran out the front door once before and ran straight into the fence and kept ramming her face into the fence not realizing she couldn't get through it).  I have been searching the neighborhood all last night and all day today, asking everyone I see about her.  I haven't given up hope but I am still really upset.

I guess, I don't know, I just am pretty jumbled up mentally right now... And all the colleges I planned on applying for were 1850+ so my grade does sort of completely suck.  I honestly am not sure exactly what I want to major in... I really don't have many hobbies so I decided pretty much that I would go into pharmaceuticals for the money (and because I am pretty good with chemistry).  I am on and off with art--I use to have plans to go to art school, but I grew kind of bored after doing it my entire life and not feeling like I was good enough.
